title: REQ · Tailwind and PostCSS are configured with design tokens and directives
summary: Tailwind/PostCSS configs and tokens in styles.css
description: Context: no tailwind/postcss config exists in game/frontend. Desired behavior: Tailwind scans index.html and src, theme extends with token colors backed by CSS variables, styles.css starts with @tailwind directives and defines the tokens. Expected result: utility classes compile in Vite. Why: foundation for the design system.
acceptance_criteria: Given tailwind.config.ts, when imported, then content includes ./index.html and ./src/**/*.{ts,tsx}
Given tailwind.config.ts, when imported, then theme.extend.colors maps background, foreground and primary to hsl(var(--...))
Given styles.css, when read, then it contains @tailwind base, components and utilities and a :root block defining --background, --foreground and --primary
Given styles.css, when read, then the existing .game-layout and .story-panel rules remain
